Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of journal entries.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to journal entries.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for journal entries.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of journal entries. You can include approval notes, supporting documentation references, or any other information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing journal entries using this footer will not be affected.
